text: Pechersk is covered. The dragon is safe. So is the hangar. Though the doorway is a little wider now.
Good. Next stop: Odesa. Enemy helicopters are coming in from the coast.
Will they hover before firing again?
Yes. Use that pause. When they launch a rocket, change altitude. The dragon can shoot it down with fire, too.
Understood. Odesa could use a quiet morning. We will have a word with their helicopters.
